title: Triggered To Workspace
text: Write input sample to MATLAB workspace when triggered, 2 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Trigger type} sets Trigger type Rising; {Variable name} sets the workspace variable name, {Decimation}, {Maximum number of rows}, {Save 2-D signals as} sets the arrangement of 2-D samples values in logged data 2-D and {Log fixed-point data as a fi object}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Data to log to workspace scalar | vector | matrix | bus

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Trigger type Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Workspace variable name yout (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Maximum number of rows
params.values: Maximum number of rows to be saved 1000 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Save 2-D signals as
params.values: Arrangement of 2-D samples values in logged data 2-D array (concatenate along first dimension) (default) | 3-D array (concatenate along third dimension)

params.name: Log fixed-point data as a fi object
params.values: Log fixed-point data as a fi object off (default) | on
